notes: New: Default languages setting - pick languages that are automatically applied to both Radio and TV every time the app starts. Radio and TV now have independent show category filter/show language filter toggles instead of one shared setting. Show bitrate badge and Compact station list toggles for station rows. Prefer audio-only streams (TV) saves bandwidth by choosing the cheapest stream when Video mode is off. Fixed: Settings' Show category filter/Show language filter rows looked like duplicates since Radio's and TV's versions had the same label - now labeled Show Radio category filter/Show TV category filter and similarly for language.
